summary: Thought #HigherEd would be different, researching and trying to solve world problems. Do good and make a good buck doing it. It isn't. It is worse. Same wine, more expensive bottles and lot more folks putting the cork screw to the world.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: Thought #HigherEd would be different, researching and trying to solve world problems. Do good and make a good buck doing it. It isn't. It is worse. Same wine, more expensive bottles and lot more folks putting the cork screw to the world.
